tables.name: products
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, price REAL NOT NULL, rating REAL NOT NULL);

tables.name: cart_items
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE cart_items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id), quantity INTEGER NOT NULL);

tables.name: payment_methods
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE payment_methods (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, brand TEXT NOT NULL, last4 TEXT NOT NULL);
